title: Jeremiah post-apocalyptic comic style (Hermann) | Krea 2 [LORA/Krea 2]
description:
An unofficial Krea 2 style LoRA inspired by Hermann Huppen’s landmark European comic series Jeremiah. This release uses the selected Final checkpoint.

About the source

Belgian comics author Hermann launched Jeremiah in 1979. The series follows the drifter Jeremiah and his companion Kurdy Malloy through a fractured post-apocalyptic America: isolated settlements, abandoned highways, militia territories, improvised trade, hostile landscapes, and survivors making difficult moral choices.

What this LoRA does

JJonesHermanStl emphasizes grounded European-comic draftsmanship, decisive ink contours, weathered faces, muted earth colors, dusty roads, ruined towns, practical clothing, hard daylight, and cinematic wilderness compositions.
